bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; test "$(realpath "$ROOT")" = "$(pwd -P)" || { echo CANONICAL_ROOT_MISMATCH; exit 71; }; ORIGIN="$(git remote get-url origin)"; case "$ORIGIN" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot* ) ;; *) echo OWNER_ORIGIN_MISMATCH; exit 72;; esac; HEAD_EXPECTED=4744dd1d4b092ca41f4104c427a65b154d9e83e6; REF=feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core; git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/$REF"; REMOTE_SHA="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"; test "$REMOTE_SHA" = "$HEAD_EXPECTED" || { echo UPSTREAM_SHA_CHANGED; exit 73; }; DEST="$ROOT/.worktrees/sticker-current"; test ! -e "$DEST" || { echo DEST_ALREADY_EXISTS; exit 74; }; if git worktree list --porcelain | grep -Fx "branch refs/heads/$REF" >/dev/null; then echo BRANCH_ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT; exit 75; fi; mkdir -p "$ROOT/.worktrees"; git worktree add --detach "$DEST" "$HEAD_EXPECTED"; test "$(git -C "$DEST" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HEAD_EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git -C "$DEST" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"; printf 'STICKER_WORKTREE=READY\nSOURCE_HEAD=%s\n' "$HEAD_EXPECTED"; (cd "$DEST" && node --test test/stickerWizard.test.mjs)
